description:
Delete the `TaxonomyRepo` copy and its label helpers from the `cli_issue` suite root once no test in the suite calls them.

## Background

Shared test support defines `TaxonomyRepo`, its constructor and its label helpers. `crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/main.rs` still defines its own copy, which the suite's modules call until their migrations move them to the shared one.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `cli_issue/main.rs` defines no taxonomy repository type, constructor or label helper.
- [hard] REQ-02: No test in the suite refers to a suite-root taxonomy helper, and each asserts what it asserted before.
title: The cli_issue suite root drops its taxonomy repository copy
